bio.text: Blay Tarnoff is the Libertarian Party candidate for New York's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.

According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey responses, he graduated from The American School of Paris, earned a bachelor's degree from Brown University in 1980 and a law degree from Pace University School of Law in 1996, and has worked as a systems engineer.
